# Results by model category

Categories describe experiment configurations, not datasets or parameter-count thresholds. Each category has separate best values; protocol boundaries still apply within it. [Classification rules](model-classification.md).

## Conventional / task-specific models

Task-specific classifiers and predictors, including BERT encoders, without generative LLM/VLM assistance.

[Separate results](results-conventional.md)

[Assembly101](benchmarks/assembly101.md), [Brain4Cars](benchmarks/brain4cars.md), [Intentonomy](benchmarks/intentonomy.md), [IntentQA](benchmarks/intentqa.md), [JAAD](benchmarks/jaad.md), [MIntRec](benchmarks/mintrec.md), [MIntRec2.0](benchmarks/mintrec2.md), [PIE](benchmarks/pie.md)

## LLM / VLM models

A generative language or vision-language foundation model participates in inference, including small foundation models and tool pipelines.

[Separate results](results-llm-vlm.md)

[IntentQA](benchmarks/intentqa.md), [MIntRec](benchmarks/mintrec.md), [MIntRec2.0](benchmarks/mintrec2.md)

## LLM-assisted training / hybrid models

LLM/VLM-generated supervision or distillation is used in training, while inference uses a conventional model.

[Separate results](results-hybrid.md)

No results recorded in this category yet.
